scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:crm
scripts.install:all: npm run install:main && npm run install:crm
scripts.install:main: npm install --prefix main/backend --legacy-peer-deps && npm install --prefix main/frontend --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.install:crm: npm install --prefix crm/backend --legacy-peer-deps && npm install --prefix crm/frontend --legacy-peer-deps
